title: Create: Dynamic Village — villager profession file
description: Defines a new villager profession. Place at config/dynamicvillage/professions/<name>.json (config, NOT a data pack — professions register before data packs load).

id.description: Profession id (your namespace), also used as the POI id.

job_site_block.description: Block whose states form the job-site POI. Use this OR job_site_tag.

job_site_tag.description: Block tag whose blocks all form the job-site POI. Use this OR job_site_block.

work_sound.description: Sound event id played while working. Defaults to the generic villager work sound.
